# understudy-phpunit

PHPUnit adapter for rasuvaeff/understudy (test double library: `when(fn () => $repo->find(123))->returns($book)`).

## Install

```bash
composer require --dev rasuvaeff/understudy-phpunit
```

## Rules

- Add `use UnderstudyPHPUnitIntegration;` inside the test class.
- After a body that reaches `assertPostConditions()` (i.e. passed), `Understudy::verifyAll()` runs; an unmet `expect()` fails the test as an assertion failure.
- A failing body keeps its own exception — verification never runs for it.
- An `#[After]` hook resets the context unconditionally; doubles never leak between tests.
- An `#[Before]` guard fails with a diagnostic when the previous context was not idle.
- Override `understudyStrictStubs(): bool` in a base class to fail unused stubs project-wide. Default: false.
- If the class overrides `assertPostConditions()`, compose explicitly with trait alias (`as understudyAssertPostConditions`) — silent shadowing disables verification.
- The trait calls `parent::assertPostConditions()` BEFORE verifying: your own post-conditions always run, and their failure is reported first.
- Verification adds exactly 1 to the PHPUnit assertion count.
- Pest: import `expect as expectCall`, or use `Understudy::expect(...)`.

## Typical test

```php
use function Rasuvaeff\Understudy\expect;
use function Rasuvaeff\Understudy\when;
use Rasuvaeff\Understudy\PhpUnit\UnderstudyPHPUnitIntegration;
use Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Understudy;

final class CheckoutTest extends TestCase
{
    use UnderstudyPHPUnitIntegration;

    public function testChargesForTheCart(): void
    {
        $books = Understudy::for(BookRepositoryInterface::class);
        when(fn () => $books->find(7))->returns(new Book(7));

        (new Checkout($books))->charge([7]);

        expect(fn () => $books->find(7));   // exactly once, verified by the trait
    }
}
```

## API

| Member | Kind | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Rasuvaeff\Understudy\PhpUnit\UnderstudyPHPUnitIntegration` | trait | verify-after-success, reset-in-`#[After]`, `#[Before]` guard, `understudyStrictStubs(): bool` |

All doubling operations live in the core package `rasuvaeff/understudy`.
